'''Robbie Hendon''' is a member of the [[Killer Bees]]<ref name="slack-kb">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Garrett Larson (deadbody), Dan Tartaglione (DTartagOne), Robbie Hendon. Quotes: "Me and Dan and Robbie"; Hendon wrote that he is on Killer Bees; Tartaglione posted "The Killer Bee's Suite is open" at 2024 Worlds</ref>. He finished '''#27''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 32; Challonge seed 28).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
